kane.summary:

Update the test to treat the login screen as the expected unauthenticated entry state, or establish a signed-in session before asserting protected home-page content. Then navigate directly to /login and verify that same sign-in form is displayed.
kane.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the app's home page loads with real content"

kane.summary:
Opening the root address led to /login, where a working sign-in form was shown. The test assumed that an unauthenticated visitor would remain on a separate home page, so its first check did not match the page state.
Update the test to expect the sign-in page after opening the root address when no session exists, or establish an authenticated session before checking authenticated home-page content.
kane.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the app's home page loads with real content"

Configure the deployment to serve the app entry point for `/login` on direct requests, then verify that opening or refreshing `https://nido-phase-4.vercel.app/login` displays the sign-in form rather than the host error page.

Update the test to either authenticate before checking protected home content or accept the login redirect as the expected result for an unauthenticated visitor.
